title: Email at the shop's own domain
problem: Shops had no way to get name@theirshop.com email from GridCommerce.
now: A setup verifies the domain, shows four DNS records that turn green, then makes mailboxes, aliases, groups and forwarders.
steps: Connect a domain in Settings › Domains.
Open Business email, pick a plan and continue.
Check the records, finish, and make a mailbox.
notes: Where: Settings › Business email (/email) · Needs the server: Mail itself (servers or a reseller) is the backend's; DNS checks are simulated.
